notes.title: Update Notes 03-30-25
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Here's a quick list of some changes made to the game:


New stealth mechanic introduced
New enemies introduced alongside new levels
New level environments introduced
New platform objects introduced
Enemy AI has been slightly refined


All five of these updates will be refined and inserted into the official game soon!

notes.title: Newest updates come to the Playtest Release!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, just like the regular game, the playtest version of the game is also getting an update, which includes the following:

New Enemies
New Tutorial Levels
A new exploratory mechanic so that Jaelyn can explore the world around her.
New music
New boss battle attacks
A real-time cutscene has been added
Level titles have been added when moving from one room to another
New traps have been added
The Drone enemy mechanics have been changed
Brand new art assets have been added


The following bugs have also been fixed:
Collisions that previously caused Jaelyn's animation to glitch have been fixed
Laser Barrier can't be passed without an ability
The map and inventory can no longer be accessed from the Game Over screen
